name: Hitozuma Yukino to... ~Tsuma ga Onna ni Kawaru Toki~
original_name: 人妻 雪乃と… ～妻がオンナに変わるとき～
source:
In the ultra-luxurious apartment complex Latour Kazuki, there’s an exclusive members-only cultural club called L’Avian Rose, reserved for the crème de la crème of society.
The club’s “Special Hospitality Division” has a secret mission for its employee, Gyomeishiki Souma: seduce and steal away the wives of the elite members—women with unshakable chastity and a strong sense of superiority.

Can Souma successfully seduce these beautiful, devoted wives and turn them into slaves of pleasure?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ005915.html/]dlsite[/url]]
